premises.text: Circuit board prototyping is a lengthy and costly process for designers.
premises.evidence_span: circuit boards run every electronic device from your car opener to your thermostat camera and even your smartphone factories around the world spit out tens of thousands of them every single day which is great for mass manufacturing but earlier in the development cycle when you just need a couple boards for prototyping it's an absolute nightmare to deal with

premises.text: Designers often outsource circuit board fabrication, leading to delays and additional costs.
premises.evidence_span: most designers outsource fabrication to facilities in China pay a couple hundred dollars and wait two weeks for delivery when the boards finally arrive they realize they made a mistake so they pay a couple hundred dollars and wait two weeks again

premises.text: A rapid prototyping tool can significantly reduce the time and cost of creating circuit boards.
premises.evidence_span: over the past year we've built a better solution a printer that can create a circuit board and the time it takes to go get lunch

premises.text: The printer allows users to design circuits in familiar software and print them easily.
premises.evidence_span: the user can design their circuit in whatever software they're already comfortable with and then as my co-founder Jesus is about to show us if they just press print

premises.text: The printer can create multi-layer circuits, enabling more complex designs.
premises.evidence_span: we're also the only prototyping tool on the market that allows you to print multi-layer circuits

premises.text: The printer can automate the assembly process, saving time for users.
premises.evidence_span: with the Voltero V1 just toss them onto the printer and it'll even dispense solder paste and bake the board for you

premises.text: Faster prototyping can enhance a company's agility and success.
premises.evidence_span: we live in a world where a company's agility determines its success so to us the choice between lead times of two weeks or just 60 minutes is an easy one to make

premises.text: Hardware developers need a faster way to prototype electronics.
premises.evidence_span: they all agree that hardware developers need a faster way to prototype electronics

premises.text: Keeping development in-house can protect larger businesses against IP infringement.
premises.evidence_span: the larger businesses can protect against IP infringement by keeping all the new development in-house

premises.text: The rapid prototyping market is expected to grow significantly.
premises.evidence_span: the rapid prototyping market is expected to reach almost five billion dollars by 2018 quadrupling from today's numbers

value.text: Designers can prototype circuits quickly and affordably, enhancing innovation.
value.evidence_span: if you need custom circuits just press print
